name: Skeptic
reason: Heat, a high historical July bloom rate and a rising satellite index all point toward a bloom, but the index is only modestly elevated, the weekly rise is small, and the rain could be diluting things, so I'll shave the confident reading.
evidence: max_temp_avg 31.1 with 6 hot days supports warm conditions, so I concede this one
bloom_rate_this_month_past_years 0.833 is a strong prior, but it is a base rate and not this week's observation
cyano_index 0.113 with change_vs_last_week only +0.016 is a modest signal that could be noise
rain_total_mm 26.9 with 0 heavy_rain_days means no major flushing but some possible mixing or dilution
